data.name: Rihana
data.gender_notes: Rihana is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'R-H-N', meaning 'to rest' or 'to soothe'. In the context of names, Rihana can be translated as 'Lady', 'Mistress', or 'Cherished One'. The name Rihana carries the meaning “Lady, Mistress” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Rihana usually hope their child will grow to embody lady, mistress and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Rihana holds spiritual significance in Islamic tradition. It is said to represent the inner joy and contentment that comes from a deep connection with God. Those named Rihana are believed to have a strong spiritual foundation and a deep sense of inner peace.
data.etymology: Rihana belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lady, Mistress.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rihana total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: ريحانة
in_arabic.meaning: ريحانة تعني الزهرة الجميلة والمميزة في اللغة العربية
